problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a circuit for a specialized courier to retrieve sensitive documents from nine corporate headquarters:

Headquarters Alpha: Situated at grid reference (125,154)
Headquarters Beta: Situated at grid reference (183,20)
Headquarters Gamma: Situated at grid reference (172,178)
Headquarters Delta: Situated at grid reference (38,90)
Headquarters Epsilon: Situated at grid reference (105,9)
Headquarters Zeta: Situated at grid reference (156,119)
Headquarters Eta: Situated at grid reference (98,117)
Headquarters Theta: Situated at grid reference (12,25)
Headquarters Iota: Situated at grid reference (120,199)

The travel durations between headquarters, measured in minutes, are precisely known:
Alpha to Gamma: 52.8 minutes
Alpha to Delta: 108.0 minutes
Alpha to Epsilon: 146.4 minutes
Alpha to Zeta: 46.8 minutes
Alpha to Eta: 45.8 minutes
Alpha to Theta: 171.5 minutes
Alpha to Iota: 45.3 minutes
Beta to Gamma: 158.4 minutes
Beta to Delta: 161.0 minutes
Beta to Epsilon: 78.8 minutes
Beta to Zeta: 102.6 minutes
Beta to Eta: 129.0 minutes
Beta to Theta: 171.1 minutes
Beta to Iota: 189.8 minutes
Gamma to Delta: 160.3 minutes
Gamma to Epsilon: 181.8 minutes
Gamma to Zeta: 61.1 minutes
Gamma to Eta: 95.9 minutes
Gamma to Theta: 221.4 minutes
Gamma to Iota: 56.1 minutes
Delta to Epsilon: 105.1 minutes
Delta to Zeta: 121.5 minutes
Delta to Eta: 65.8 minutes
Delta to Theta: 70.0 minutes
Delta to Iota: 136.4 minutes
Epsilon to Zeta: 121.2 minutes
Epsilon to Eta: 108.2 minutes
Epsilon to Theta: 94.4 minutes
Epsilon to Iota: 190.6 minutes
Zeta to Eta: 58.0 minutes
Zeta to Theta: 172.0 minutes
Zeta to Iota: 87.7 minutes
Eta to Theta: 125.9 minutes
Eta to Iota: 84.9 minutes
Theta to Iota: 204.8 minutes

Due to a security protocol, direct travel between Headquarters Alpha and Headquarters Beta is strictly prohibited.
Furthermore, for operational security, the courier's route must incorporate exactly one of two designated secure corridors: either the link between Beta and Gamma, or the link between Gamma and Delta.

The objective is to determine the minimal-duration circuit that visits each headquarters precisely once before concluding at the point of origin.
